title: Quantized State-Space Models for Edge Sequence Modeling: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: State-space models (SSMs) offer linear-time sequence modeling but introduce substantial memory overhead during recurrent state updates. We propose an 8-bit dynamic fixed-point quantization framework for selective state-space layers. Evaluating on Long Range Arena, our quantized model preserves 99.1% language modeling perplexity while reducing KV-cache memory footprints by 3.8x on mobile ARM processors. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 3.8x and a verified task accuracy of 99.1% with mean execution latency of 14.2ms.
